maddeler.e:
تنتوون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَوُونَ (tantawūna) /tan.ta.wuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَوَى (intawā)
# تُنْتَوَوْنَ (tuntawawna) /tun.ta.waw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَوَى (intawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
